# opnsense_bind_primary_domain (Data Source)

Reads a primary BIND zone by UUID or by semantic view + domain identity.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Legacy UUID lookup.
data "opnsense_bind_primary_domain" "by_id" {
  id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010"
}

# Preferred semantic lookup: BIND zone identity is view + domain name.
data "opnsense_bind_primary_domain" "internal" {
  domain_name = "example.net"
  view_name   = "internal"
}

# Optional low-level compatibility when a view UUID is already available.
data "opnsense_bind_primary_domain" "by_view_id" {
  domain_name = "example.net"
  view_id     = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain_name` (String) Semantic zone name. Lookup is trimmed, case-insensitive, and ignores one trailing dot.
- `id` (String) UUID selector or resolved UUID of the zone.
- `view_id` (String) Optional low-level semantic view UUID selector, or resolved view UUID.
- `view_name` (String) Preferred semantic BIND view selector. Lookup is trimmed and case-insensitive.

### Read-Only

- `allow_query_acl_ids` (Set of String)
- `allow_rndc_transfer` (Boolean)
- `allow_rndc_update` (Boolean)
- `allow_transfer_acl_ids` (Set of String)
- `also_notify` (Set of String)
- `dns_server` (String)

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `expire` (Number)
